ETMS_survey_end.block_1/StudyPurpose: A study to understand how people respond to various social scenarios and how they see themselves, particularly in light of insights  as to their behaviour compared to that of the majority.
ETMS_survey_end.block_1/WereYouEvaluated: I felt that the part where I answered social scenario questions giving my probably response was being evaluated and judged against what others would do.
ETMS_survey_end.block_1/Feedback_interpr: It was interesting, though it didn't surprise me. I also considered perhaps everyone was told they are a bit socially awkward (though not in those words) to see how they would respond to that. In my case, I do feel it was probably an accurate assessment.
ETMS_survey_end.block_1/Suspicious: Yes, I did have a sense that perhaps the feedback being given was telling everyone the same thing (suggesting a degree of social helplessness) or alternatively that maybe everyone was given feedback but it was somehow randomised and not based on their responses to the social scenario questions at all. I'm not sure why I thought this but I guess I assumed a lot of people feel a bit out of their depth in social situations so many would just assume they would score poorly and it would not arouse suspicion.
